overall_summary: Dataset is small with a clear outlier (Husband-Wife dynamic at 1.6k views) compared to other relational and parental content averaging 100-300 views. General confidence is low, so we lean towards exploring family dynamics and relationship realities while keeping a strict narrative structure.

winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video (or5gtaBpRVY) achieved 1,666 views, significantly outperforming all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife or close partnership unspoken tensions.

winning_patterns.evidence: Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota (NO5fdHLxFL4) secured 373 views, second best.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational relationship realizations as strong hook foundations.

weak_patterns.pattern: Repetitive sibling tropes without high-tension hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) performed poorly at 18 and 135 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic family appreciation; introduce specific conflict or guilt elements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Self motivation video (JPf_3ebfnuk) underperformed at 172 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from direct motivation toward grounded emotional situations.
